Problem Statement:
Implement a C program that reads a string from the user and removes every third character from the string using pointer arithmetic. The program should then print the modified string. 
Input Description:
A single string s (maximum length of 100 characters). 
Output Description:
Print the modified string after removing every third character. 
Sample Input:
abcdefghijklmnopq 
Sample Output:
abdeghjkmnpq
